page.overview:
Who is AWOL?

AWOL is a character who appears in the G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game by Renegade Game Studios. She is used as a part of the introductory adventure, Snake Pit.

AWOL is a Cobra Trooper who was formerly in the United States Army. Not much of a talker, she mostly joined Cobra for the opportunities for violence. She is a member of Scar Squad and takes part in Faceless' plan to infiltrate The Pit

G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game (Renegade Game Studios), p. 318, "Snake Pit Introductory Adventure"
